reason: I read every label, and a named lab with the report for my batch behind a QR code is exactly what I look for. 200 mg bisglycinate with no oxide and a money-back guarantee makes one box at $24.99 an easy thing to try before bed.
objection: Made in China from a brand I have never heard of. I would open the lab report before paying and make sure the lab is real and the batch number matches. And it is still two capsules every day.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report turned out to be generic, missing, or for a different batch than the box, I would not buy.
